app.setupCancelled: Setup cancelled. No files were changed.
app.refreshFailed: Could not refresh. It will be tried again shortly.
app.orderNotSaved: The order could not be saved. The previous order was restored.
app.orderNotPersisted: The order was not saved. The previous order was restored.
app.enabledNotSaved: {name}: the setting could not be saved. The change was undone.
app.enabledNotPersisted: The tool setting was not saved. The previous state was restored.
app.themeNotSaved: The appearance could not be saved. The previous theme was restored.
app.languageNotSaved: The language could not be saved. The previous choice was restored.
bridge.unreachable: The background service cannot be reached.
reorder.nowTray: The tray icon now shows this tool.
reorder.unavailable: The order cannot be changed because the background service cannot be reached.
header.title: Usage
header.pin.labelOn: Stop keeping the panel on screen
header.pin.titleOff: Keep the panel on screen — right now it closes when the pointer leaves it
header.pin.titleOn: The panel stays on screen — it stays open even if you switch to another app. Click to release.
header.fresh.titleOffline: No connection to the background service. The values shown are not updating.
header.fresh.titlePending: First scan in progress. There is no measurement to show yet.
header.fresh.titleAging: {stamp}. No new measurement for longer than expected.
header.fresh.titleStale: {stamp}. The values shown are no longer current.
header.spoken.aging: No new measurement for longer than expected.
header.spoken.stale: Warning: the values shown are not current.
header.settingsTitle: Settings — which tools the panel shows, how it looks, and its language
header.settingsCloseTitle: Close settings and return to the usage list
panel.reorderHelp: Drag to change the order, or hold Alt and use the up and down arrow keys. Alt and Home moves to the top. The five-hour window of the top tool is drawn on the tray icon.
panel.coach: The tray icon may be in the hidden icons area: open the arrow on the taskbar and drag the icon out. The panel now opens when you click the icon, not when you hover over it.
panel.empty.noneAdded: No tools are on the main panel.
panel.empty.noneDetail: A supported tool appears here once you install it.

panel.empty.noneAddedDetail.one: The {count} detected tool has not been added. You can add it in Settings.
panel.empty.noneAddedDetail.other: None of the {count} detected tools have been added. You can add the ones you want in Settings.

panel.offline: Could not connect to the background service. The values shown are not updating.
panel.modePinnedTitle: The panel is pinned: it stays open even if you switch to another app.
panel.modeHoverTitle: The panel is not pinned: it closes when the pointer leaves it. The pin button in the header keeps it on screen.
providers.noneFound: No supported AI tool was found on this machine.
provider.antigravity.notRunning: Antigravity is not open, so its values are not updating — nothing is wrong. Only the last measurements that are still valid are shown below; open Antigravity for the current figures of windows that have expired.
provider.claude.usageSource: Calculated only from local Claude Code transcripts.
meter.window5h.label: 5-hour window
meter.window7d.label: Weekly window
meter.notSupplied.reason: This tool does not publish this limit
meter.notSupplied.spoken: {label}: this tool does not publish this limit, so no percentage can be shown.
row.tokens.cacheRead: Cache read {value} (not included in the billable total)
row.notConnected: This tool is not connected yet.
row.burnTitle: Billable token rate in the active window
row.gripTray: The tray icon shows this tool.
row.gripTrayNoData: The tray icon shows this tool, but it is not connected, so no data is drawn.
cost.caveat.allUnpriced: This week's usage is not in the price list at all, so no amount is shown. Models used:
cost.caveat.someUnpriced: Some of this usage is not in the price list and is not included in the total:
cost.caveat.ttl: {scope} did not record a TTL. A write without a TTL is priced at {low}; 1-hour writes actually cost {high}, so the total is a lower bound.
cost.caveat.degraded: Data from this tool is not current. The amount covers only the last readable events, so it does not describe the whole window.
cost.summary: Would have cost {amount} at published API prices
cost.toggleLabel: {provider}: this week's usage would have cost {amount} at published API prices. This is not a bill; you do not pay this amount under your subscription. Activate to open the breakdown.
cost.unpricedSummary: This week's usage is not in the price list
cost.unpricedToggleLabel: {provider}: this week's usage is not in the price list, so no amount can be calculated. Activate to see the models used.
cost.detailLeadUnpriced: No price could be calculated for this usage
cost.denial: This is not a bill: you do not pay this amount under your subscription. It is what the same usage would cost through the API.
cost.pricesDateMissing: The price list's date was not reported

quota.spoken.one: {provider}: quota is kept separately for {count} model, {shape}. Activate to open the per-model breakdown.
quota.spoken.other: {provider}: quota is kept separately for {count} models, {shape}. Activate to open the per-model breakdown.

quota.derived: These figures were decoded from the tool's own local data store. It is not a documented interface and may change silently when the tool updates.
quota.degraded: Data from this tool is not current; these figures are from the last readable measurement.
quota.lead: Quota is kept separately per model family.
quota.denial: These figures are this tool's own quota only. The model names below show the models you ran here; they have nothing to do with the quotas of tools that have their own row in the panel.
settings.back: Leave settings and return to the usage list
settings.models.help: Choose which tools appear on the main panel. Removing a tool only takes it off the list — it stays connected and no data is deleted.
settings.theme.help: The panel's colours. With System, the Windows setting is followed.
settings.theme.helpSystem: Following the Windows dark/light setting — currently {resolved}. The panel changes when the setting does.
settings.language.help: The language of the panel, the tray icon and notices. With System, the Windows language is followed.
settings.usage.intro: What each period's usage would have cost at published API prices. This is not a bill — you do not pay this amount (US dollars) under your subscription.
settings.usage.empty: No local usage records were found yet.
settings.usage.note: Prices from the list dated {date}. “At least” means a lower bound: usage that could not be priced is not included in the total.
settings.usage.noteNoDate: The price list's date was not reported.
